status: Bank-specific scenario estimates using shared macro v1; regulatory threshold 13% corroborated by the September 2026 BoG Monetary Policy Report; not investment advice.

anchor.method: Use the observed September balance sheet and year-to-date earnings. Q4 is estimated from the 9M run rate with a scenario multiplier. 9M gross loans and allowance are not disclosed: estimate 9M gross from 9M net using the FY2025 reported allowance/gross ratio, then treat allowance = gross - net as an estimate. No historical imputation.

loan_growth.method: 2027 onward nominal GDP approximation = shared real GDP growth + CPI inflation, plus a bank-specific spread in percentage points; 2026 Q4 net loan growth applied to the September actual. Annual growth capped/floored at -10% and 35%.
loan_growth.reason: FY2024 gross loans 5,840.975m fell to FY2025 5,121.328m; September 2026 net loans 4,674.926m vs FY2025 net 4,491.827m. Assume moderate normalisation rather than trend extrapolation.

deposit_growth.method: Nominal GDP approximation plus spread; 2026 Q4 from the September deposit balance.
deposit_growth.reason: FY2025 customer deposits 5,843.183m; September 2026 7,156.119m, a strong inflow. Assume growth normalises toward nominal GDP.

investment_yield.method: Use 50% shared 364-day T-bill and 50% representative medium-term government bond yield; a portfolio mix proxy, not a reported yield.
investment_yield.reason: Implied FY2025 securities yield is roughly consistent with a blend of the 364-day bill and the 10-year post-DDEP yield.

loan_yield.method: Shared policy rate plus a scenario spread in percentage points.
loan_yield.reason: Standalone loan-specific yield is not reconciled to the interest-income note; the spread is an analyst stress assumption, aligned with peers' models.

cash_yield_factor.method: Cash and BoG balances yield = shared policy rate multiplied by this factor; effective blended yield, not a quoted reserve rate.
cash_yield_factor.reason: FY2025 interest income is consistent with a low yield on the large cash/BoG balance relative to the policy rate.

cost_of_funds.method: Interest-bearing funding cost = shared policy rate multiplied by this factor; applied to average customer deposits, due to banks and borrowings; effective blended cost, not a quoted deposit rate.
cost_of_funds.reason: FY2025 interest expense 222.703m against average FY2024-FY2025 deposits and borrowings of roughly 6,475m is about 3.4%; 9M-2026 annualises to about 2.4%.

fee_growth.method: Shared nominal GDP proxy plus spread; preserve the fee expense/income ratio unless stress applied.
fee_growth.reason: Fee and commission income grew from 158.644m (FY2024) to 169.469m (FY2025).

opex_growth.method: Shared CPI inflation plus a percentage-point spread.
opex_growth.reason: Staff and other operating expenses grew sharply in FY2025; inflation plus a growth-related overhead is a transparent sensitivity, not guidance.

cost_of_risk.method: Loan impairment charge / average gross loans; scenario percentage. No repeat of the FY2022 DDEP event assumed. Floor modelled impairment at the increase in allowance stock to prevent an unfunded allowance build.
cost_of_risk.reason: FY2025 impairment was a net credit; 9M-2026 charge 27.165m against gross loans near 5,329m annualises to about 0.7%. Base reflects a normalisation upward from a low base.

npl_pct.method: 2026 year-end based on the reported 9M 13.98%; subsequent scenario target, not a forecast from loan-level data.

allowance_to_gross_pct.method: Gross loans = net loans / (1 - allowance ratio) at FY2026E; later allowance stock = gross x ratio.
allowance_to_gross_pct.reason: FY2025 reported 629.501m / 5,121.328m = 12.29%, matching the reported loan loss provision ratio of 12.29%. 9M-2026 gross/allowance unavailable.

tax_rate_pct.method: Effective tax on positive PBT; no automatic deferred tax benefit for losses.
tax_rate_pct.reason: FY2025 effective tax 35.43% (217.764/614.765); 9M-2026 35.38%. 25% corporate rate plus levies. Forecast uses a blended 35%; future levy law changes not assumed.

dividend_payout_pct.method: Payout on positive PAT; constrained if a capital target or cash minimum is breached.
dividend_payout_pct.reason: FY2021 dividend 80.842m / PAT 184.330m = 43.9%; FY2022 48.387m / 108.840m = 44.5%. Scenario payout sensitivity.

capital_ratio_target_pct.method: Management buffer (percentage points) above the shared minimum CAR, not an official target; RWA intensity calibrated from the FY2025 audited RWA / assets, then independently flag any minimum shortfall.
capital_ratio_target_pct.reason: FY2025 regulatory capital and RWA are disclosed; 9M-2026 reported CAR 18.52% but no interim RWA/capital breakdown.

q4_income_runrate_multiplier.method: Scale Q4 revenues by the scenario multiplier; Q4 funding expenses multiplied by 1.25 downside / 0.9 upside / 1 base, OPEX 1.10 downside / 1 base / 1 upside, and Q4 risk charge by estimated gross loans and scenario risk / 4; keep the actual 9M flows fixed. Impairment is subject to the allowance-stock floor.

fx.method: The Bank does not disclose a separate net monetary FX position in the summary statements used, so no incremental FX translation P&L is modelled; the balance sheet is not revalued by currency. Flagged rather than guessed.
fx.reason: Avoid inventing a currency split that is not in the sources.

cash_reserve.method: Proxy required reserve = scenario CRR x year-end customer deposits. Cash and BoG balances include non-eligible cash, so this is a liquidity screening test, not regulatory compliance.

model_structure.method: Hold non-core balance sheet lines proportional to deposit growth, except property/other assets grow with opex; stated capital and other reserves held constant; securities follow deposit growth; cash balances plug the accounting identity, flagging negative balances or a reserve shortfall without automatically borrowing. RWA = gross loans + FY2025 calibrated residual risk intensity x (total assets minus gross loans). Q3 regulatory capital anchored on reported CAR x estimated RWA; Tier1 capital anchored using the FY2025 CET1 / total regulatory capital relationship. Retained profit increments regulatory capital; dividends constrained to pre-dividend cash and the CAR buffer. Report a proxy, not a regulatory return.
model_structure.q4_opex_balance_growth: Annual opex growth divided by four for Q4 property and other assets.
model_structure.allowance_bridge: Implied write-offs/other reductions = opening allowance + modelled impairment - closing allowance; the impairment floor is max(risk-based charge, allowance stock increase, zero). Movements are scenario estimates, not observed write-offs. FY2026 opening allowance is estimated; Q4 only.
model_structure.cash_residual: Do not hide negative cash; show the reserve and funding gap. Cash is the reported cash-and-BoG aggregate, so regulatory compliance is not established.

notes: All numeric driver assumptions are analyst estimates, not reported bank results or management guidance.
2026 income must retain reported 9M results plus separately estimated Q4; model checks must flag any liquidity or capital shortfall.
Shared macro v1 numeric paths are used. Regulatory minimum CAR of 13.0% is quoted in the Bank of Ghana September 2026 Monetary Policy Report; not re-derived here.
Societe Generale Ghana is a Bank (separate) model; Group/consolidated figures are never mixed in.

macro_snapshot.note: Use all three shared scenarios; rerun after macro revisions. A missing required driver is a hard error.
